CustomField.description: When checked, AIPlatformLogManager publishes AIPlatformLogEvent__e for every AI Assist exception. Unchecked, no log events are published and no AIPlatformLog__c records are written.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Step 1 of 2. Turn off to stop exceptions being published as log events at all. Turn off only temporarily, for example during a bulk data load.
CustomField.label: Is Exception Logging Enabled
